subject: Shiny-server open source timeout issue loading an app

messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: Shiny-server open source timeout issue loading an app
parts:
I installed shiny-server open source on a new RHEL 7.2 server....sample apps work fine.

I tried an app that accesses a large SQLite database to populate some of the ui elements.  The app works fine locally.

When connecting on the server there is a slight delay on start up (3-4 seconds) then the ui appears and the app immediately crashes (greys out with a server disconnected message)

Searching the web it was suggested that either the process was running out of memory or a timeout condition was causing the disconnection. 

I monitored memory usage with htop and there seems to be no problem there.

I set the SHINY_LOG_LEVEL to TRACE  and it appears that  it is a timeout problem.
m[2017-07-13 10:46:01.136] [TRACE] shiny-server - ^[[39mTimeout expired. Killing process

The Timeout expired happens between 8 and 12 seconds after the R process starts.  I tried increasing the app_init_timeout value to 120 seconds (from the default of 60) with no effect
I also changed TimeoutStartSec in /etc/systemd/system/shiny-server.service to 30 from the default of 10  but this also seems to have no effect (kill signal is still 8-12 seconds after start of the R process).

Are there other time_outs that are relevant?  Anyone have a clue?

Best regards,

Mike
